description.en: SciConBench evaluates AI agents on open-domain scientific conclusion synthesis using 9,110 questions and expert-written conclusions from systematic reviews. The evaluation decomposes conclusions into atomic facts and measures correctness and comprehensiveness via factual precision and recall.

evidence.snippet: We introduce SciConBench, a large-scale live benchmark of 9.11K questions and expert-written conclusions from systematic reviews to evaluate open-domain scientific conclusion synthesis.
